neo.text: Boseiju is the ancient tree around which Towashi was built: the builders razed the surrounding forest but left it unscathed, and the emperor later brokered an agreement halting the city's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of the tree.

Boseiju began to grow again until it eclipsed the city's tallest structures, and beneath it Jugan collected the essences of the other dragons and placed them in an egg with Ryusei, sealed in Boseiju for fifty years.
After the fifty-year slumber the dragons hatched reborn in new forms, with Jugan as Kura, Keiga as Kairi, Kokusho as Junji and Ryusei as Atsushi.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Tamiyo corrupted Boseiju and the tree burst apart.
